where.if: AND (RECEIPT_NO LIKE '%' || #{q} || '%' OR TITLE LIKE '%' || #{q} || '%' OR APPLICANT_NAME LIKE '%' || #{q} || '%')

mapper.select:
SELECT * FROM ( SELECT COMPLAINT_ID, RECEIPT_NO, KIND, LEGAL_AFFAIR, APPLICANT_NAME, TITLE, DEPT, ASSIGNEE, STATUS, RECEIVED_AT, DEADLINE, COMPLETED_AT FROM CIVIL_COMPLAINT
ORDER BY CASE WHEN STATUS = 'DONE' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, DEADLINE ASC NULLS LAST, RECEIVED_AT DESC ) WHERE ROWNUM <= #{limit}

SELECT NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN STATUS = 'RECEIVED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS RECEIVED, NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN STATUS = 'IN_PROGRESS' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS IN_PROGRESS, NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN STATUS <> 'DONE' AND DEADLINE <= #{imminentUntil} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS IMMINENT, NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN STATUS = 'DONE' AND COMPLETED_AT >= #{monthStart} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS DONE_THIS_MONTH FROM CIVIL_COMPLAINT
